slides.prompt:
Edit the supplied approved Lightweight slide as a strict layout template for LW-CAR-0019. Produce ONE finished 1080 × 1350 px portrait 4:5 slide. Preserve its layout, exact copy, scale, hierarchy, poses and equipment, subject only to the explicit changes below. This is a controlled body illustration style test, not a redesign.

BACKGROUND: remove the entire pale arch from the template. Fill the WHOLE canvas with solid opaque off-white #F0F1EB, then draw a uniform fine notebook GRID behind all content, #E1E2DA lines 2 px wide at every 54 px horizontally and vertically. Absolutely NO arch, NO transparency, NO checkerboard, NO progress bar, NO slide counter.

LOGO AREA: remove the old top-left wordmark completely, leave the top 110 px as uninterrupted grid background and free of ALL text, badges, figures and decoration. DO NOT draw any logo or brand wordmark. The exact owner's transparent logo file will be inserted as a separate layer after generation at x48,y19,341×71px; do not leave a box, patch, panel or background rectangle for it.

COPY AND TYPOGRAPHY: Rubik for ALL text; dark #2A2A2A. Preserve every specified string exactly, including hyphens, case, spaces and punctuation. No additional text, signatures, watermarks, annotations or variant letters. All lettering fully visible and unclipped. No green or sage anywhere on the bodies. All people are the same bald faceless male fitness mannequins, athletic natural build and featureless smooth pelvis without anatomical detail, matching the reference proportions. Do not add clothes or modify poses. The target muscle must be immediately legible in coral #F26445. Keep the slide as full and informative as the template; simplify only the rendering of the body and equipment.

SLIDE 1 — COVER. Two huge stacked headline lines occupying the upper ~45% below the logo area, exactly "WEAK" in #2A2A2A then "BACK?" in #F26445, heaviest Rubik weight, with the template's subtle headline shadow and small coral paint-splat dot under and right of "?". Keep same two line breaks and scale-to-fit; do not shorten text. No other text. Lower ~60%: the large rear-view mannequin from hips up, slightly overlapping bottom of headline. Viewer's right arm raised and flexed, other hand resting on hip, exact same pose as template, bottom cropped. Lats, traps, rear delts and teres highlighted coral #F26445; non-target body sand/ivory. Simplify the body according to the variant below rather than retaining the template's anatomy fibres.

VARIANT A — FLAT SHAPES. Redraw all bodies from flat colour shapes, like a modern app illustration. Sand #D9CBBE body with a few lighter ivory #F5F0E5 areas. The target muscle is a bold clean flat #F26445 shape. The silhouette, proportions and pose stay as in the template. Equipment is simplified flat black/grey/white shapes.

Return exactly one opaque complete slide, not a montage, comparison, mockup or sheet.
